_note: Open-access sources for the Phase 6 evidence corpus. Every entry was checked against Europe PMC's license field: CC BY, CC BY-NC, or CC BY-NC-SA only (no CC BY-NC-ND, since chunking is a derivative use). The text itself is downloaded by app/rag/build_corpus.py into data/corpus/ (git-ignored); only this manifest is committed. Citation metadata (authors, journal, year, DOI, license) is read from Europe PMC at build time.
